This page lists the people credited for [[Matcha Flavoured]], as given in the README, the datapack's <code>CREDITS.md</code> (<code>CREDITS.txt</code> until 1.12.8-beta) and the release notes.<ref>{{Source|README.md}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/CREDITS.md}}</ref> The pack's design, code and textures are by '''Klei Wright''' unless noted.

== Contributors ==
=== Music ===
* '''Ciren''': the music disc "Golden", added in [[Matcha Flavoured 1.0|1.0]] in memory of the developer's dog, Dakota.
* '''DeBlezyBestie''': music discs; the older credits file named "Malachite", "Crete" and "Elegy of The Abbey".
* '''Vee Vaicekauskas''': background music; the older credits file named the tracks "Refuge", "Abbey", "Ruby", "Through Hell" and "Estus".<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/CREDITS.txt|at=34a04e6571d9ee6f0cc1d8d50cdfa85980720156}}</ref>
See [[Music]].

=== Art ===
* '''imtlx''': fishing sounds and the new [[Angler's Almanac]], translation and GitHub help.
* '''Movpasd''': the gradated biome and foliage color maps.
* '''Voxybuns''': custom effect and intrinsic icons ("custom emojis") and their implementation.
* '''Pepurion''': rose models.
* '''Zergologist''': the original lapis lazuli textures.
* '''roliuu''': Axiom and Easy Shulkers interface textures.
* '''MrHatsy''': chiseled sandstone texture.
* '''LambS0up''': purple Nether portal texture and the withered heart asset.
* '''IrrelevantGaymer''': brick, bed and sandstone texture work after 1.12.2,<ref>[https://github.com/kleiwright/matcha-flavoured/commits/{{Source/commit}} Commit history of the pack repository]</ref> and the leatherback sea turtle.
* '''ToastNeko''': the copper knife and the Wither tabula base.
* '''TheGenderGoblin''': the 3D fish models.
* '''Bobot-Dev''': all the 3D food models.

=== Code ===
* '''Linkershim''': optimizations, multiplayer support and other code.
* '''Hashiru''': optimizations, including non-ticking armor, particles, warding stones and crystal hearts.
* '''HapppySpud''': removing gravel from Hell, keeping enchantments when smithing, random asylum seekers, hellspore generation, and several fixes.
* '''FloofShade''': the item update trigger. See [[Updating items]].
* '''Pepurion''': optimizations and many bug fixes.
* '''ReinIsNOTaDev''': optimizations, the GitHub workflow, the timeline-based day length and the item update system (see [[Updating items]]).
* '''Internet-Hyena''': the new pig and chicken features; the 1.12.8-beta notes also credit them for crafting lanterns from steel.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.8-beta|quote=Lanterns can now be crafted from Steel (Internet-Hyena)}}</ref> The released pack has no such recipe yet.
* '''fautore''': toggleable [[heart container]] loss.
* '''Fpekal''': bug fixes, optimizations and the 26.3 port.
* '''milo256''': dynamic multiplayer sleep.
* '''NamelessJu''': code suggestions, Modrinth issues and translation.
* '''TankyAibem''': the [[favorite food]] trade, added after 1.12.2.
* '''Tralomine''': trims on the pack's custom armor, and a fishing advancement fix.
* '''Fayranchia''', '''EastMonster''' and '''CubertCuberton''': bug fixes and suggestions.
* '''Bingbongbooper''': food ideas.

=== Builds and structures ===
* '''Linkershim'''.
* '''TankyAibem''': chicken roosts.
* '''Grim-O''': the plains and desert villages.

=== Translation ===
The translation project is led by '''Natroute''', with the spreadsheet compiled into JSON by '''imtlx'''. The README credits: Zevran, Ithlil and Alaska (French); Pepurion (Russian); Fellter_CZ and Exmori (Czech); NamelessJu, Flix8 and Koguri3108 (German); Flix8 (Swiss German); Seba (Chilean Spanish); Joxer021 (Spanish); Phonem (Turkish); deneben (Canadian English); Vee (British English); EastMonster (Simplified Chinese); Knoctis and Sego_dk (Danish); imtlx and malberee (Ukrainian); Briefle and Yassin (Italian); Kuzuyukii (Polish); HapppySpud and imtlx (joke English variants).

Since 1.12.3 the resource pack also carries a <code>translation_credits.md</code> that lists the translators of each language. It adds Gemz (Brazilian Portuguese), SodaMochi (Japanese), TheOnlyMann (Korean), ozzy_gg (Dutch), BraveDark and Pearoo (Hungarian), StartsMercury and Rein (Tagalog), athenaya and natroute (Turkish), and Voxy (French), and lists the Anglish and Pirate Speak variants under HapppySpud.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/translation_credits.md}}</ref>

== Inspirations ==
The credits stress that none of the following people know of or endorse the pack.
* '''Raspmary''', whose modpack ''Raspberry Flavoured'' inspired the pack, including electrum, shakudo, hepatizon and divine fragments (now pith).
* '''JermsyBoy''', whose resource pack ''A Little Taste of Jerm'' the textures were first based on and later redrawn to resemble.
* '''MiziraGamez''', for the framework for endless repairing.
* '''Gooporeal''', whose resource pack inspired the lichen models.
* '''Vectorwing''', for inspiring many textures.
* '''Rhythmic''' (PurpurMC), for the framework for looting shears.
* '''alexin1337''', whose resource pack ''No XP Numbers'' gave the framework for the shader that hides the experience level number, added by HapppySpud in 1.12.7-beta (credited since 1.12.8-beta).
